Circuit Puzzle - Brain Training: Connect the Wires -

Nov 5, 2026
Rotate the tiles. Complete the circuit! Can you bring a scrambled circuit back to life? Remember those simple puzzles that looked easy until you tried them? This time, a circuit board is your playground in a satisfying rotation puzzle that is easy to learn and tricky to master. Rotate tiles covered with wires until every connection lines up correctly. One turn at a time, restore the circuit and watch the electronic board come together. How to play: • Observe the circuit board design • Rotate the tiles to change their direction • Connect the wires correctly and complete the circuit The rules are simple, but finding the right direction takes careful observation and a spark of intuition. Seeing scattered wires join into a complete circuit delivers a wonderfully satisfying finish. Whether you enjoy testing your focus and problem-solving skills or just want a quick brain-training break, this puzzle is a welcoming choice for beginners and experienced players alike. Rotate each tile and bring the circuit back to life!

Play & Learn My First Korean

See it. Fill in Hangul! Can you recognize the right Korean word from a picture and its meaning? If you are just starting out, learning a new language can feel intimidating. This game makes your first steps into Korean simple and fun. Complete Korean words by filling in the blank with the correct Hangul. Illustrations and Japanese meanings help you understand familiar everyday words as you play. How to play: • Check the illustration and the Japanese meaning. • Choose the correct Hangul from the answer choices. • Complete the Korean word in the blank.
